tools.name: scan_app
tools.description: Run twelve deterministic checks against the outside of a public web app and return a dated verdict: the stamp, the open/closed/not-checked counts, every line with its plain-English consequence, what was skipped, and the receipt id and URL. Free, no token. It reads public pages only: it does not sign

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Read a receipt back as JSON by its id. Folded, it returns the twelve lines and a pay object naming where a human pays. With a bearer token that has credit it unseals: the evidence and the fix paragraph for every open line, and the SOTA Security Model read of the app. One fixed price per unsealed rep

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_receipt" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
